name: BadgeGuru Nursing Badge Reference Cards (33 Cards)
seoTitle: BadgeGuru Nursing Badge Cards for New Nurses
metaDescription: BadgeGuru badge cards with 33 double sided references for nursing students and new nurses. A useful graduation gift that clips right behind an ID badge.
summary: A graduation gift that keeps working after the party: 33 double sided BadgeGuru reference cards that clip behind a badge for new nurses and students.
whyItWorks: The first months after nursing school are full of moments where a new nurse knows the answer but wants to double check. Pulling out a phone mid shift can look unprofessional, and a pocket notebook gets lost in the laundry. Badge cards stay right where they are needed, flipping out from behind the ID for a quick glance and tucking away again.

BadgeGuru is a name many nursing students already recognize, which makes this a safe choice if you are shopping without much nursing knowledge yourself. The double sided design gives 66 cheat sheets in all, so the recipient can pull out the ones that match their unit and leave the rest for studying for boards or a new specialty. As a graduation gift, it bridges school and the first job nicely. A preceptor could also hand a set to an orientee as a welcome to the unit. Add a good pen and a handwritten note of encouragement to make it feel personal.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for card orientation to make sure it matches the recipient's badge.
Look at the listing to see which topics are covered, since the title does not list them.
The cards are a quick reference aid, and nurses should always follow their facility's policies.

faq.q: Is this a good graduation gift for a new nurse?
faq.a: Yes, it fits that stage well because new grads are still building confidence and like having quick references during orientation.

faq.q: Do experienced nurses use badge cards?
faq.a: Some do, especially when changing specialties. For a veteran nurse on the same unit for years, a personal or comfort gift may land better.
